text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens holding valid ordinary foreign passports, aged between 18 and 45, in good health, with a proper character. They must meet the conditions for entering and leaving China, abide by Chinese laws and regulations, and respect Chinese culture and customs.2. Residents of the Chinese mainland (mainland), Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who, after immigrating to a foreign country, apply as international students to China must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years (inclusive), and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025) (9 months of actual residence abroad can be counted as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps). 3. High school graduation or above.4. Applicants under the age of 18 must submit the following scanned documents:(1) Guardianship guarantee letter (the guardian must be an adult residing permanently in Shandong Province, China);(2) Notarized power of attorney signed by the applicant's parents and the guardian;(3) Guardian's ID card or passport.5. Whether the applicant has Chinese nationality at the same time as having a foreign nationality is determined by the nationality determination conclusion of the Chinese public security exit and entry administration department. If it is determined that the applicant has Chinese nationality after applying, being admitted, and starting school, their application, admission qualification, or study qualification will be cancelled.
